explanations.explanation: In the word 'اِنَّمَاۤ', at the 2nd letter (position 2 of 4), we find Noon Sakin. The next letter 'ن' (within the same word) belongs to the Yarmaloon letters (ي ر م ل و ن). This means we apply Idgham (إدغام), which is the rule of merging. Since the letter 'ن' is one of (ي و م ن), you must perform idgham with a nasal sound (ghunnah), also called Idgham with Ghunnah (إدغام بغنة).
